subject: x-axis labels using interacting x variables

messages.author: 8f92b1b8d64c1a7d
messages.subject: x-axis labels using interacting x variables
parts:
Good morning,

I often plot using x = interaction(A, B), and will also make colored points or bars that correspond to either A or B. Since the legend explains the colored variable, I only want my x-axis to specify the other. Is there a way to specify the x-axis labels to be A or B, instead of the default A.B?

Thanks!
Stefanie Trop

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: x-axis labels using interacting x variables
parts:
Just do aes(x = A, colour = B) ?

Hadley
